sources.title: T-Mobile — Calling services
sources.scope_and_limit: Carrier forwarding models and limitations. Does not establish a Redial partnership, consumer-account OAuth integration, or universal spam-only routing.

sources.title: Verizon — Call Forwarding FAQs
sources.scope_and_limit: All-call/unanswered forwarding and the distinction between forwarding voice calls and text messages. Match the real account and device before publishing instructions.

sources.title: AT&T — Call Forwarding
sources.scope_and_limit: Wireless-phone setup, voicemail interactions and forwarding limitations. Not evidence of an online API for controlling every consumer line.

sources.title: Twilio — Media Streams
sources.scope_and_limit: Media transport, bidirectional stream limits and request authentication. Does not certify this proposed bridge or its transfer implementation.

sources.title: xAI — Speech to Speech
sources.scope_and_limit: Realtime WebSocket audio, client/server authentication distinctions and supported audio formats. The sample voice.space-xai.dev address in the prototype is not validated by this documentation.

sources.title: xAI — Pricing
sources.scope_and_limit: Voice audio reference of $0.08/minute at review time, plus separately listed text-input/tool costs. Recheck the selected model and account before pricing a plan.

sources.title: Twilio — US Voice Pricing
sources.scope_and_limit: US local inbound, app/browser, Media Streams, number rental and other voice charges. Public unit rates are not a complete bill or a contracted quote.

sources.title: xAI — SIP voice integration
sources.scope_and_limit: Candidate alternative voice transport. Documentation existence is not proof of a tested Redial SIP implementation.

sources.title: Square — Subscriptions API overview
sources.scope_and_limit: Subscription/catalog/payment relationships and documented constraints. Redial free membership is an internal entitlement, not a $0 Square subscription.

sources.title: Square — Plans and variations
sources.scope_and_limit: STATIC versus RELATIVE pricing, phases and discount applicability. Use tested mappings instead of importing Stripe assumptions.

sources.title: Square — Manage subscriptions
sources.scope_and_limit: Create/manage/cancel behavior and associated objects. Provider subscription state is not sufficient evidence that an invoice was paid.

sources.title: Square — Validate webhook notifications
sources.scope_and_limit: Signature-key, notification-URL and raw-body verification. Validation precedes event persistence and side effects.

sources.title: Supabase — Row Level Security
sources.scope_and_limit: RLS, database grants and privileged-key implications. These primitives do not automatically implement the line-sharing/privacy policy proposed here.

sources.title: Resend — Domain introduction
sources.scope_and_limit: Domain ownership and email authentication setup. Preserve existing mail routing and evaluate changes before publishing DNS records.

sources.title: Apple — App Review Guidelines
sources.scope_and_limit: Payment rules and the free companion-app provision in 3.1.3(f), subject to actual eligibility. No guarantee that Redial will qualify or be approved.

sources.title: Google Play — Understanding payments policy
sources.scope_and_limit: Digital-service billing requirements and applicable exceptions/programs. Apple eligibility does not establish Google Play eligibility.

sources.title: Android — CallScreeningService
sources.scope_and_limit: On-device screening response constraints, including the five-second response deadline. Not evidence of universal access to cellular-call audio.

sources.title: Chrome — Extension service workers
sources.scope_and_limit: Event-driven worker lifecycle and architecture. Persistent voice sessions must not assume the extension worker remains alive.

sources.title: Chrome — Service-worker events tutorial
sources.scope_and_limit: Persisted state and testing worker termination/restart. Opening developer tools may affect lifecycle tests.

sources.title: Chrome — Extension service-worker basics
sources.scope_and_limit: Manifest V3 packaged-code constraints. Do not execute remote model-generated code in the extension.

sources.title: Expo — Development builds introduction
sources.scope_and_limit: Custom native runtime requirements and distinction from Expo Go. Native voice SDKs require an appropriate development/build workflow.

sources.title: Nous Research — Hermes Agent source
sources.scope_and_limit: Agent runtime and tool/skill integration candidate. Pin and inspect the release, dependencies, license and configuration before deployment.

sources.title: Paperclip — Project source
sources.scope_and_limit: Agent/task execution, coordination and governance candidate. Repository existence does not grant Redial production credentials or authority.

sources.title: xAI — Grok Bot overview
sources.scope_and_limit: Hosted agent/workspace model and shared-computer considerations. Treat as a separately governed external teammate, not a self-hosted voice gateway.

sources.title: MCP — Security best practices
sources.scope_and_limit: Authorization, token handling and boundary protections. Protocol connectivity does not substitute for application permissions.

sources.title: FTC — CAN-SPAM compliance guide
sources.scope_and_limit: US commercial-email baseline for review. This is not an exhaustive jurisdiction-specific legal assessment of Redial.

sources.title: Twilio — A2P 10DLC
sources.scope_and_limit: US long-code application messaging registration context. Registration is not a substitute for appropriate recipient consent.

sources.title: Next.js — Self-hosting
sources.scope_and_limit: Self-hosted web runtime and deployment considerations. Select and test actual locked versions instead of blindly copying an old manifest.

sources.title: shadcn/ui — Next.js installation
sources.scope_and_limit: Component installation reference. Reconcile existing Tailwind/React conventions before using a current generator.

sources.title: Supabase — Self-hosting with Docker
sources.scope_and_limit: Full self-hosted service stack and operational responsibilities. A Postgres container alone is not the whole Supabase platform.

sources.title: Coolify — Next.js framework example
sources.scope_and_limit: Deployment starting point. Voice gateway isolation, backup restoration and release draining are additional proposed requirements.
